commands: set -eu; DB="$HOME/tracker-field-captures/2026-09-13-post-walk-v68/tracker_database"; test -s "$DB"; echo TABLES_BEGIN; sqlite3 "$DB" '.tables'; echo TABLES_END; for t in devices device signal_samples signalSamples alert_history alerts; do if sqlite3 "$DB" "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='$t';" | grep -q 1; then echo SCHEMA_$t_BEGIN; sqlite3 "$DB" "PRAGMA table_info('$t');"; echo SCHEMA_$t_END; fi; done
